_rules: Light D&D. Attack: d20 + toHit >= target AC hits. Recovery is seconds before that hand button lights up again. Mana regenerates 1 per 10 steps walked, never in combat. Values are for hero level 1; +1 toHit every 2 levels, +10% damage per level. Only the front two heroes can use melee; back-row melee hands are greyed out. Monsters attack only the front two, unless a flank or ranged monster says otherwise.

off.effect: block: +4 AC for Brannoc and the next hit on anyone is halved
heal the most hurt hero for 6-10

main.note: ranged, works from the back row

off.effect: pocket sand: monster misses its next attack; picks the chest/lock if aimed at one

monster_attack.note: monsters roll d20+toHit vs a front-row hero's AC; interval is per monster in monsters.json

potions.potion_red: health: restores 15 HP to the tapped hero
potions.potion_green: cleanse: removes attached leeches and cures poison on the tapped hero, plus 5 HP. No poison in Act 1 yet besides leeches, so it's the leech answer.

_expected_floor1: Sim (levels/tools/sim_floor1.py, 5000 runs, no shield/sand/potions, monsters swing first at 0.5s, player first tap after 1-2s): leeches 2s, rat 3s, crab 6s, slime 8-9s, guard-hall rat 3s; total HP lost mean 22-26, 90th pct 32-37; a front hero drops to 0 in 1-3% of runs without potions. If monsters do NOT get the opening swing it falls to ~13 HP lost, too easy.

torch.use: puzzle fuel for offering bowls and the floor 4 altar; used up when placed
torch.rules: Tap a lit wall torch: Take or Snuff. Taken: bracket becomes empty; held torch only swings (fire damage). Put it in any empty bracket to light that spot, or drop it in water to put it out. Snuff costs 1 oil to relight.

iron_shield.effect: block: +3 AC and the next hit on the holder is halved

chain_mail.for: anyone but ilsevar (blocks spellcasting if worn by him)

ashmantle_hammer.note: optional reward from the floor 4 drill tiles

oil._note: Wren's lantern oil (Levie). 1 oil lights 1 dead torch. Her ember never goes out, so puzzles and dark stretches always stay playable with 0 oil.

progression._note: Levie. Simple on purpose. XP is shared: every hero gets the full amount.
progression.critical: natural 20 always hits and doubles damage; natural 1 always misses. Same rule for monsters.
progression.xp_per_kill: equals the monster's max HP (bog leeches 12, rat 14, crab 24, slime 40, spider 20, drowned dwarf 35, Dural 60)
progression.act1_target: about level 2 after floor 1, level 4 by the end of Act 1

per_level.heal_on_level_up: no, only the new max HP is added to current HP

progression.downed: at 0 HP a hero is down: can't act, isn't targeted. If both front heroes are down, monsters hit the back row. Wren's heal or a red potion tapped on a downed hero brings them back with that amount. After a fight, downed heroes get up on 1 HP so you can never be stuck. All four down = game over, with two buttons: 'Last autosave' and 'Start of floor'.
progression.bag: 12 slots. Potions, oil flasks and keys stack up to 5 per slot; gear takes one slot each.
progression.autosave_rules: Autosave only out of combat, with no monster within 2 squares, and never when every hero is under 25% HP. Keep the 2 most recent autosaves. A separate floor-start snapshot is taken on arriving down the stairs and is always offered on game over. Until saves exist (before step 4), game over restarts the floor from that snapshot.

perks._rule: At level 3 and level 5 each hero picks one of two perks. Picks are permanent and saved. Each perk changes a number you can feel in a fight.
